entries.scope: Public evidence register, deterministic table generation, monthly CI and profile publication
entries.rationale: One reviewed public register and snapshot generate synchronized README tables; methodology and command help define reproducible interpretation.
readerPaths: Profile or Level-0 README -> method -> register and snapshot -> reproduction commands
entries.navigationImpact: Add a public run table and one methodology link; preserve existing profile MOTD and content order.
entries.languageStrategy: German table on both public entrypoints; equivalent English README partner and bilingual methodology/help
entries.platformAndExampleProof: macOS Bash entrypoint and PowerShell fixture tests; native Linux/macOS/Windows CI tests on the proposed PR head
entries.risk: False completion claims, private source inclusion, or divergent profile values; addressed through reviewed pinned evidence and deterministic generation.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Counting rule, source visibility, evidence, registry scope, README markers or workflow permissions change.
